hypothesis: Competitive spatially anchored object slots plus joint strong-action adaptation make episode-safe cross-replan visual history diverse and causally useful beyond the complete B4 context.
objective: Pass focused tests and finite eight-B200 optimization; keep slot mean absolute off-diagonal cosine below 0.95; make aligned-history held-out action loss at least 1 percent lower than both zero-history and batch-shuffled-history matched interventions.

config.overrides: R2 competitive slots; eight 2x4 anchors; diversity weight 0.05; initial gate 0.1; train strong_action_expert; 500 optimizer steps; warmup 50; cycle 500; save 500; batch 64 per rank; DP8; accumulation 1; max validation batches 8

data.version: RoboCasa365 B4 processed split plus Wan latent cache and visual-history sidecar
data.revision: 1143698 fixed records; 280 shards; same-physical-episode t-36/t-24/t-12 visual-history lookup; no future or cross-episode lookup

command: launch_b5_vom_probe_r2_8gpu.sh followed by launch_b5_vom_matched_val_r2.sh none, zero, and shuffle; formal 20k remains blocked unless every acceptance gate passes.
hardware: pyrogpucompute1; 8 x NVIDIA B200 183359 MiB; batch 64 per rank; global batch 512

preflight.gpu_smoke: B200 BF16 forward/backward finite; slots [8,8,1024]; peak allocation 226.44 MiB

conclusion: Competitive assignment and the diversity loss eliminated slot collapse, but the trained action expert did not causally use sample-specific cross-replan memory. The formal 20k run was not launched.
failure_reason: Aligned memory failed to improve held-out action loss by 1 percent over either intervention: it was 0.02387 percent worse than zero and 0.00073 percent worse than shuffle.
